{{Quote|The number of Imperial casualties is still unknown. Admiral Tyzen is expected to comment later today, but we've already seen an escalated response level. Curfew was reinstated for the entire city.|The reporter, regarding events in Ghorman|<ref name="Messenger" />}}
A [[human]] '''reporter''' was present at [[Palmo Plaza]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[2 BBY]], they detailed recent events that occurred in [[Palmo]] from the plaza.<ref name="Messenger" /> They were later present in the plaza detailing operations being conducted by the [[Galactic Empire]], with themselves being watched on a screen by [[Eedy Karn]] on the planet [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Who Are You?">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The reporter appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's seventh episode, "[[Messenger]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Messenger" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The reporter was portrayed [[Taniel Yusef]] and listed in the series' credits as simply "Reporter #2".<ref name="Messenger" />
